transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

Well, I guess what brings me in is... I just hardly eat right anymore. Some days it's really just coffee and maybe a piece of bread for the whole day. I've lost a lot of weight, too. My pants are just hanging loose on me now.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
No, it's nothing like that. I'm not afraid of getting fat or anything. I just... I don't know, I just don't have an appetite at all. It's not on purpose, I just don't feel like eating.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
Yeah, I have. Most days I just wake up with this... this heavy, empty feeling right in my chest. It's like nothing good is waiting for me out there, you know? I just want to keep my head down.
Have you had thoughts about wanting to die or hurting yourself?
No, I haven't... I don't have thoughts like that. I mean, I feel really miserable, but I don't want to die. I haven't ever thought about hurting myself.
Have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah. I used to really like walking by the lake, or working on my little model kits. But now... they just sit there. I look at them and it's almost like they belong to somebody else. I just don't have any interest in them at all anymore.
How long have you been feeling this down and uninterested in things?
It's been... about five months now. Yeah, this depressed spell has just been hanging over me for about five months.
Has this been making it hard for you to manage your usual daily responsibilities?

Yeah, it really has. Since things got this bad, I'm just not keeping up with my basic errands the way I used to. I've had to ask my relatives to step in and help me out a lot. They've been helping me with money, giving me rides places, and dealing with any paperwork for me. I just can't seem to manage it on my own right now.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people don't seem to?
No, nothing like that. I haven't... I haven't heard any voices or seen things that aren't there. It's nothing like that.
Have you been moving or speaking noticeably more slowly than usual?

Yeah... my family actually tells me I move like I'm walking through mud lately. And, well, sometimes it just takes me a really long time to answer even a simple question they ask me. It just takes a while to get the words out.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?

Yeah, it's been really hard. Lately I just... I'll either lay there in bed for hours staring at the wall, or I end up waking up way before the sun and I just can't get back to sleep. And honestly, even on the nights when I do manage to sleep, I still just wake up feeling completely worn out.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?

Yeah, it's been really bad. I try to look at forms or bills and I just... I can't keep my mind on them at all. And even doing basic stuff, like going to the store, I just end up standing there stuck over the smallest things. Like, I'll just stand in the aisle trying to figure out what can of soup to buy, and my brain just won't work.
Have you been feeling worthless or blaming yourself a lot?

Yeah, I have. I just... I keep thinking I'm no good because I lost my job, and now my relatives have to help me out with everything. It's just hard. I sit around and replay every mistake I've ever made, and it just feels like I ruined everything.
Have you been worrying a lot about many different things?

No, not really. I mean, I feel awful about losing my job and needing help, but I wouldn't say I'm worrying about a whole bunch of different things. It's not like I'm nervous or stressed out about everything else going on. I'm mostly just... stuck feeling bad about what already happened, not really worrying about other stuff.
